note: SWIFT's IBAN Registry, the column for Somalia, as the copy gives it. A national check inside the BBAN, where the country has one, isn't in the registry and isn't modelled: a number drawn here passes the IBAN's own check. Release 103 (September 2026) is SWIFT's current; changes since this copy aren't read.

sources.title: SWIFT, IBAN Registry (ISO 13616), its text release: the copy in GNU Taler's iban-tools (registry.txt, commit 81b6dbcb, 2025-02-18; its latest country update December 2024), read there because swift.com answered every request with HTTP 403 on 2026-10-30
sources.said: Name of country: Somalia | IBAN prefix country code (ISO 3166): SO | BBAN structure: 4!n3!n12!n | BBAN length: 19 | Bank identifier position within the BBAN: 1-4 | Branch identifier position within the BBAN: 5-7 | IBAN structure: SO2!n4!n3!n12!n | IBAN length: 23 | IBAN electronic format example: SO211000001001000100141
